prompt_en: I want to add a button that exports the order list to a spreadsheet file.
prompt_zh: 我想加一个按钮，把订单列表导出成表格文件。

prompt_en: The login page goes blank after I enter my password, and I want it fixed for good.
prompt_zh: 登录页输入密码后就变成空白，我想彻底修好它。

prompt_en: I want to tidy up the messy payment code without changing what it does.
prompt_zh: 我想把乱糟糟的支付相关代码整理一下，但不改变它的行为。

prompt_en: I want automated tests that make sure checkout keeps working.
prompt_zh: 我想加一些自动测试，保证下单流程一直能正常工作。

title_zh: 从零搭建一个小型网页应用
prompt_en: I want a small web page where my team can write down what they did each day.
prompt_zh: 我想做一个小网页，让团队每天记下自己做了什么。

prompt_en: The search page takes about five seconds to show results, and I want it much faster.
prompt_zh: 搜索页要等五秒左右才出结果，我想让它快很多。

prompt_en: I want the settings page to look cleaner and be easier to use.
prompt_zh: 我想让设置页看起来更清爽、用起来更顺手。

prompt_en: I want to upgrade the main framework this project uses to its latest version.
prompt_zh: 我想把项目用的主要框架升级到最新版本。

prompt_en: I want a short guide that explains how to install and run this project.
prompt_zh: 我想写一份简短的说明，讲清楚这个项目怎么安装和运行。

title_en: Write a script or process data
prompt_en: I want a script that merges several spreadsheets into one summary.
prompt_zh: 我想写个脚本，把几份表格合并成一份汇总。

title_en: Not sure yet, help me think it through
prompt_en: I have a rough idea but have not worked it out yet, so let us talk it through.
prompt_zh: 我有个大概的想法，但还没想清楚，想先跟你聊聊。
